NP Presspad 1.3.11 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — dependency updates only, no user-facing changes. **No companion plugin update needed.**

This release refreshes the libraries NP Presspad is built on. Everything here is under the hood; the app looks and works exactly as before.

## Dependency updates

- **Electron** 44.9.0 → 44.9.3 — the application framework (Chromium + Node.js runtime), with the latest fixes from the Electron 44 line.
- **Auto-updater (electron-updater)** 6.8.10 → 6.8.11 — the component that delivers these updates to you.
- **Lucide icons** 1.59.0 → 1.61.0 — the icon set used across the interface.
